data.content: The well-known beverage company, Relax, enlisted our creative abilities to craft attention-grabbing billboard slogans designed to make travelers pause and ponder.
Infused with a touch of humor, we artfully crafted messages that subtly promoted the importance of slowing down in traffic.
We brainstormed various slogans, including "Relax, Baton: Put down that phone”, "Relax, Lutw: There's no rush," "Relax, Hana: for you is waiting Nana" and more. All those slogans rhymed in Albanian.

A wide array of slogans immediately went viral on social networks after their publication, receiving thousands of shares and becoming trending topics on various portals. We also encouraged citizens to submit their own proposals, and the best suggestions were displayed on bridges along with their authors.
